about:
Centric Medical is a privately held medical device company based in Huntley, Illinois. Established as the Foot & Ankle Division of Life Spine, the company focuses on developing solutions for distal extremity conditions. Its headquarters are located at 13951 Quality Drive in Huntley.

The company designs and manufactures medical devices intended to improve procedural efficiency and efficacy in foot and ankle surgery. Its approach combines innovative design, uncompromising quality standards, and technologically advanced manufacturing platforms. Details on specific production processes, facility size, employee count, or annual volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Centric Medical serves the orthopedic medical device market, providing products used by surgeons and hospitals for foot and ankle procedures. The company holds issued and pending patents on its technologies, reflecting a commitment to proprietary innovation.

The company states its mission is to improve the quality of life for patients with distal extremity symptomatology through innovative design, rigorous quality standards, and advanced manufacturing capabilities. This patient-focused mission drives its product development and manufacturing philosophy.
